name: karpathy/autoresearch · baseline example
summary: Source-backed baseline architecture for karpathy/autoresearch commit 500114a035cb63a4fc1829036e064b22870c61b4, the starting model for the exp/H100/mar8 history. This example contains no measured experiments or historical hypotheses.

baseline.label: 8192 vocab × 512 · bf16
baseline.detail: BPE vocabulary of 8192 (trained by prepare.py), embedding width = model dim. Init std 1.0.

baseline.label: alternate layers · gate 2σ(32 ch)
baseline.detail: ResFormer-style value residual: a per-layer token embedding mixed into V with an input-dependent gate per head, on every other layer (the last always included).

baseline.label: RoPE base 10K · QK-norm · FA3 · full MHA
baseline.detail: Causal self-attention with head dim 128, rotary embeddings (base 10,000), RMS-normed queries and keys, FlashAttention-3, as many KV heads as query heads.

baseline.label: SSSL · short = ½ context (1024)
baseline.detail: Sliding-window attention per layer: S = half context (1024 tokens), L = full 2048. The last layer is always L.

baseline.label: 4× · ReLU²
baseline.detail: Two linear layers (d → 4d → d) with squared ReLU, no biases.

baseline.label: resid λ 1.0 · x0 λ 0.1
baseline.detail: Learned per-layer scalars: one scales the residual stream, one mixes the initial embedding x0 back in at every layer.

baseline.label: depth 8 · AR 64 → dim 512 (4 heads)
baseline.detail: model_dim = depth × ASPECT_RATIO rounded up to a multiple of HEAD_DIM (128). Pre-norm blocks (RMSNorm), attention then MLP.

baseline.label: untied · logit softcap 15
baseline.detail: Separate unembedding (init std 0.001); logits squashed with 15·tanh(x/15).

baseline.label: uniform ±√3/√d · c_proj = 0
baseline.detail: Attention and MLP input matrices uniform in ±√3·d^-½; output projections start at zero; embedding std 1.0, lm_head std 0.001, value-embedding gates at zero (neutral).

baseline.label: LR 0.04 · momentum 0.85→0.95 over 300 steps · ns 5 · β2 0.95
baseline.detail: Muon with Nesterov momentum and a NorMuon-style second moment for every transformer matrix, grouped by shape.

baseline.label: β (0.8, 0.95) · emb 0.6 · unemb 0.004 · scalars 0.5
baseline.detail: AdamW for embeddings, value embeddings, lm_head and the residual scalars; LRs scaled by (d/768)^-½.

baseline.label: cautious 0.2 on matrices (→0) · none elsewhere
baseline.detail: Cautious weight decay (only where the update and the weight agree in sign) on Muon matrices, decaying linearly to 0 over training. No decay on AdamW groups.

baseline.label: no warmup · 50% warmdown · final 0
baseline.detail: Time-based: flat LR, then a linear warmdown over the last half of the 5-minute budget to 0.

baseline.label: 524K tokens / step
baseline.detail: 2^19 tokens per optimizer step, sequence length 2048, device batch 128.

baseline.label: seed 42 · no grad clipping
baseline.detail: Fixed seed; gradients are not clipped.

diagram.description: Baseline decoder-only transformer. Each layer mixes the residual stream with the initial normalized embedding, then applies attention and an MLP with separate residual additions. Value embeddings and attention windows modify the attention path; their settings appear below.
